scope: Rasmus and Pedro fitted art proof; built-in imagegen; six calls including targeted repair

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve.
Asset type: production painted character base turnaround for detachable clothing fit proof.
Image 1 is the exact identity and style reference: Rasmus is the orange fox in its FIRST ROW ONLY. Preserve his orange-and-cream fur, big triangular ears, huge round head, tiny dark paws, small oval eyes, cheek blush, compact belly and white-tipped fox tail. Ignore all other characters.
Draw Rasmus alone eight times, in an evenly spaced FOUR COLUMN by TWO ROW transparent sheet. Top row left to right: front looking toward viewer (S), front-left three-quarter looking to IMAGE LEFT (SW), exact LEFT profile (W), rear-left three-quarter facing away toward IMAGE LEFT (NW). Bottom row left to right: exact back view (N), rear-right three-quarter facing away toward IMAGE RIGHT (NE), exact RIGHT profile (E), front-right three-quarter looking toward IMAGE RIGHT (SE).
Each view is a separately authored turn of the SAME physical fox, NOT a horizontally flipped drawing. No duplicate views. Back views conceal face/cream chest. Keep same short body height, head size, foot baseline and full figure scale in all eight cells. Keep tail's natural attachment at rump, never a pasted front appendage.
Bare furry base body only, safe cream belly fur; NO shirt, trousers, hat, boots, bag, collar, jewelry or held object. Arms relaxed slightly away from belly with both small rounded paws visible wherever anatomically possible. Keep paws at waist height so detachable clothing cuffs can fit behind them. Feet slightly apart; no walking pose.
Same approved matte hand painted storybook gouache/watercolor with soft paper grain, delicate slightly uneven warm brown pencil edges, neutral daylight. Soft 2D illustration, no plastic or 3D rendering, no pixel art. Genuine alpha transparency. No ground shadow, text, labels, lines or cell background. Generous transparent gutters separating all eight FULL silhouettes; ears, tails, paws and feet completely inside cells. Landscape sheet.

Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve.
Asset type: painted character base turnaround for detachable clothing fit proof.
Image 1 is exact identity and style reference: Pedro is the pale blue-white ghost in its LAST ROW ONLY. Preserve his rounded teardrop wisp head with curl, little dark oval eyes, soft pink cheeks, short floating mitten hands, round scalloped hem and cool blue watercolor edges. Ignore other characters.
Draw the SAME Pedro alone EIGHT times, evenly spaced FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS on genuine alpha transparency. Top row left to right: exact front S; front-left three-quarter SW looking to IMAGE LEFT; exact LEFT profile W; rear-left three-quarter NW facing away toward IMAGE LEFT. Bottom row left to right: exact back N with no face; rear-right NE facing away toward IMAGE RIGHT; exact RIGHT profile E; front-right SE looking toward IMAGE RIGHT.
He has NO HUMAN LEGS OR FEET. Short floating mittens at waist height, slightly away from torso, no fingers or weapon. The scalloped lower wisp is his innate body silhouette, NOT a floor-length garment to add over human legs. Same neutral pose, figure height, round head size and lower hem baseline in all cells. Separately author all views, no mirror or duplicate images. Rear directions conceal facial features appropriately.
Remove the reference's neck bow/collar so this is a clean safe unclothed GHOST base, no hats, collars, clothing, jewellery, tools or held items. Keep body covered by its natural pale wisp, no nudity. Clothing will later be separate opaque cream linen and brown woven tabs rather than recoloring the ghost.
Approved matte storybook gouache/watercolor with fine uneven warm-grey pencil contour and subtle paper grain. Soft 2D painted illustration, no glossy 3D or pixel art. Preserve gentle blue edge translucency against a truly TRANSPARENT background, no glow or floor shadow. Generous clear gutters; all curls, hands and hems inside cells. Landscape sheet. No labels, text, guides, cell lines or other props.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent detachable garment layer sprites matching the provided Rasmus fox base, NOT inventory icons.
Image 1 is exact fox base reference, body proportions and direction order. Image 2 establishes clothing materials ONLY (straw hat, cream shirt, brown boots). Paint EMPTY clothes with transparent holes, NO character inside.
Portrait production sprite sheet with FOUR COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS of separate individual cutouts. Every row has the same four items: column 1 SMALL woven straw hat with sage ribbon and TWO clear fox EAR HOLES; column 2 very SHORT wide cream linen button shirt with short sleeves and transparent neck opening; column 3 tiny warm brown trousers with paired short legs, little waistband and tail opening at back; column 4 PAIR of small brown soft boots, viewed together at the matching angle.
Row 1: front S; row 2: front LEFT three-quarter SW; row 3: exact LEFT profile W; row 4: rear LEFT three-quarter NW; row 5: exact BACK N; row 6: rear RIGHT three-quarter NE; row 7: exact RIGHT profile E; row 8: front RIGHT three-quarter SE. Turn the SAME physical garment, never merely copy or mirror views. Shirts back hide buttons; boots side views have two overlapping boots, not a single giant boot.
Fit: the fox has a huge head above a tiny rounded lower torso. His shirt must be very SHORT AND WIDE, reaching only collar-to-waist, not a long human tunic, and have short wide cuffs so little paws can lie in front. Trousers are short and rounded like a toddler's, not human adult proportions. Keep front/back panels and cloth seams. Hat is modest and sits BETWEEN the visible fox ears, not covering or replacing them.
Approved matte storybook gouache/watercolor, delicate irregular warm-brown pencil edges, honey straw, desaturated sage ribbon, creamy linen folds, soft saddle-brown cloth/leather, minimal dull brass. Neutral daylight, no shadows or baked glow. No 3D, gloss, pixel art, vector icons or thick black outlines.
Each of the 32 complete cutouts is centered in its own cell with WIDE transparent gutters on all sides. Real alpha background, no labels/text/grid/cell fill. Nothing overlaps a neighboring cell. No bodies, faces, hands, feet, mannequins or extra items.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing 4-column, 8-row EMPTY garment sprite sheet to correct. Preserve the layout, all 32 cells, painted style, overall object size, colors, and transparent background.
Change ONLY these issues:
1. EVERY hat in column 1 currently has fake orange fox ears built into it. REMOVE ALL ear/fur shapes. These are empty detachable hats, no body parts. Leave TWO actual open TRANSPARENT oval ear holes through the woven crown/brim where ears will pass through. Straw/sage ribbon only. The complete fox ears live on the separate body layer and must not be drawn on a garment.
2. Row 6 (third row FROM BOTTOM) represents rear-RIGHT three-quarter NE. Its shirt currently shows a front collar and buttons: repaint this shirt as its BACK viewed turning away toward image RIGHT. No front buttons in row 6. Make this matching rear-RIGHT stance equally clear for that row's empty hat, trousers and boots. Row 4 is rear-LEFT, row5 exact back; preserve these correct rear views.
Everything else unchanged. Empty garments only, no characters, NO EARS anywhere. Four columns (hat, shirt, short trousers, pair boots), eight rows (S,SW,W,NW,N,NE,E,SE). Keep all gutters genuinely alpha transparent. No text, labels, shadow or background.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: eight directional held-sword attachment sprites for a small cozy painted hero.
Image 1 is materials and identity reference ONLY: use the short iron sword in ROW 2 COLUMN 2. Broad modest worn grey iron blade, small dull brass rounded guard, brown leather wrap, little brass pommel. Keep it compact and friendly, never gore or menace.
Draw EXACTLY EIGHT empty sword sprites in FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS on true alpha transparency, large clear gutters. All blades point VERTICALLY UP, with pommel at bottom, so the grip can be socketed to a small hand and animated in code. Physical weapon length and grip proportions identical in each. The sword is turned around its LONG AXIS relative to the hero as he turns; top row S,SW,W,NW; bottom row N,NE,E,SE. First is broad front face, second oblique front, third narrower side, fourth oblique rear, fifth broad BACK face, sixth other oblique rear, seventh opposite narrow side, eighth other oblique front. They are eight independently painted physical views, no flipped reused drawings. Blade can have one small off-center worn nick for identity; no engraved text.
Grips fully visible, WITHOUT hands, people, scabbards, effects or motion trails. Flat orthographic asset perspective, restrained soft neutral daylight. Matte storybook watercolor/gouache with visible pigment grain and fine warm-grey pencil outline, exactly like reference. No 3D gloss, realism, black thick outlines, neon glow or pixel art.
Keep each sword entirely within its own cell, generous transparency around all sides, consistent length and pommel baseline. Landscape sheet. No labels, guides, background wash or floor shadow.
